QuestInfo.name: Lava of the Abandoned Mine
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2020009##k told me to go see #b#p2030008##k, the guardian of the Abandoned Mine in El Nath, if I want to get #q2121003#. He drinks lava?? I know he's the guardian of the Abandoned Mine, but would he really know such a thing?
QuestInfo.2: The guardian of Abandoned Mine, #b#p2030008##k said it's impossible to drink lava. However, #q2121003##k is too appealing for me to give up now. He says that the blacksmith, #b#p2020000##k, could make a container that can hold the lava...

0.0: To sum up my study of #b#q2121003##k, 'swallow' in the sentence means literally, you swallow something, rather than a metaphor. It's worth a shot!
0.1: You look like one of the best magicians who deals with fire. You can get #q2121003# that you long for, if you are willing to trust the book.
0.2: It won't be easy. As an elder magician of Ossyria, I can give you a clue about #r#q2121003##k. Would you like to get #q2121003# magic?

yes.0: If you want to get #q2121003# magic, go to see the keeper of the snow mountain in El Nath, #b#p2030008##k. I'm sure if this book is real or not, but it's worth testing it!

no.0: If you don't want to do the work, then you don't deserve #q2121003#.

1.0: What can I do for you?

yes.0: Magic book? #q2121003#? I'm not a magician so I have no idea. One thing for sure is that humans can't drink lava. Humans can't even make the container to drink lava. That's nonsense.
yes.1: Although...there may be someone who can make it.#b#p2020000##k is the best blacksmith in El Nath. Do you know him? Maybe he can make a bottle strong enough to carry the lava...

npc.0: Aren't you going to see Adobis? You are afraid of learning #q2121003#? Strange...why reject such power?
